title: 2-adic even blow-up Tate normal form y^2+xy=x^3+a2x^2+a4x+a6 — three-open gluing v33
description: Working v33 on beal-conjecture: CompatChart2t (191 lines) checks chart_eq_quotient_2t for the principal divided 2t equation; CompatChartXt and CompatChartYt (105 lines each) check the graph-ideal saturations J_X=(G_X:X^∞), J_Y=(G_Y:Y^∞) and quotient-induced charts. CompatPolynomialRestrictions checks six directed polynomial-to-abstract restrictions. SpecialFibrePolynomialCover uses the three explicit polynomial spectra as literal cover objects. SpecialFibreGluing (167 lines) checks six Spec.map compatibilities, the abstract triple cocycle, and the global isomorphism Proj(ReesMod2) ≅ Glue(S_2t/(2), S_Xt/(2), S_Yt/(2)); product overlaps remain abstract pullbacks, without polynomial presentations. TateEvenBranchGenericFibre (59 lines) packages the actual blow-up generic-fibre isomorphism Bl_I[1/2] ≅ Spec(R_Z[1/2]). The existing 2,249-line TateEvenBranch chart file was not refactored. Seven targeted files passed direct lake env lean checks; their axiom reports contain only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; the scoped sorry scan is empty. A full lake build BealGeneral was not verified, and a standalone large special-fibre file check timed out without diagnostic. Neither a global identification of the actual special-fibre pullback with the quotient Rees Proj nor a degree-one quotient/nonvanishing-of-overline(2t) theorem is advertised. This is not a general Beal proof. DOI pending: Zenodo is expected to mint a DOI after the v33 GitHub release event from beal-conjecture; no DOI is assigned here.
